records.description: Finamie turns your voice into detailed financial insights, automatically. Log expenses hands-free, track your spending, and understand your money like never before.

records.name: PowerDesk
records.tagline: The File Explorer you wish Windows came with
records.description: PowerDesk is a modern, keyboard-first file manager for Windows built with Electron, React, and TypeScript. It replaces Windows Explorer with a VSCode-inspired interface featuring tabs, dual-pane browsing, a powerful search engine, built-in tools, and a fully customizable UI.

records.name: PeachCam Live, 1v1 Video Call
records.tagline: Skip the swiping. Talk face-to-face, right now.
records.description: Most "meet new people" apps turn into another feed to scroll — swipe, match, then a text thread that goes nowhere. PeachCam skips all of that: open the app, get matched with one verified, real person online right now, and just talk camera on, face to face. No group rooms, no crowd watching, no bots. Every profile passes a live-photo check before it can go live, and you can leave any call in one tap, no explanation needed. Browsing who's online is free.

records.name: Apirelio
records.tagline: Know which customers are affected by API failures
records.description: Apirelio is customer-aware API observability for B2B SaaS teams. It connects failures, latency, releases, and API version adoption to the exact customers and integrations they affect. Engineering, support, and customer success get a shared view of customer impact, with privacy-safe SDKs for PHP, TypeScript, and Python that never capture request or response payloads.

records.name: STBLSS
records.tagline: Open-source, stateless stablecoin payment terminal
records.description: Sending stablecoin invoices shouldn't force you to choose between middleman custody or running a full backend server. STBLSS is a 100% open-source, stateless stablecoin payment terminal. It formats raw ERC-20 transfers for USDC and USDT directly in your browser with built-in EIP-55 checksum address validation to stop typos before you send. Share payment links across Base, Arbitrum, and Ethereum with zero accounts, zero databases, zero tracking cookies, and zero middleman smart contract risk

records.name: Ailume Music
records.tagline: Free AI song maker with vocals, lyrics & beats
records.description: Free AI Song Maker — create songs with vocals, lyrics & instruments in seconds. Royalty-free music for YouTube, TikTok, podcasts. No credit card needed.

records.name: Zinley
records.tagline: Your Personal AI Representative for calls, email, and tasks
records.description: Most AI waits inside a chat. Zinley is reachable by you and the people around you. With its own phone number and email, it answers calls, handles email, books things, and gets work done within your rules. It remembers your people and relationships, then reports back in your language. Not another chatbot. A second you that shows up.

records.name: Undercurrent — Throughline Tracker
records.tagline: Track how a novel's theme evolves, chapter by chapter
records.description: A free Notion template for tracking how a theme develops across an entire novel — built for writers revising their own manuscripts and for AP Lit/Lang students practicing thematic analysis. Log every chapter or scene, tag it to a theme, mark whether it advances/complicates/resolves that theme, and instantly see where the theme goes quiet using built-in filtered views. Duplicate and start tracking in under a minute — no paid plan required.

records.name: ATLOCK
records.tagline: Local-first Windows security suite for protecting your PC ⭐
records.description: ATLOCK is a local-first Windows security suite that helps protect your files, passwords, and desktop without relying on cloud services. It combines NTFS-based file protection, an encrypted password vault, Intruder Ops with webcam photo and video capture, desktop lockdown, local security logs, and a modern Windows interface into one application. Designed for users who value privacy and control, It keeps your sensitive data on your device while delivering practical, everyday desktop security.

records.name: Lighting Go
records.tagline: Chandeliers, Pendant Lights, Ceiling Lights for Sale
records.description: Browse pendant lights, wall lights, ceiling lights, flush mounted lamps at lightinggo.co.uk - Up to 60% off. Affordable prices on all kinds of lights - Contemporary and traditional lamps for your choose for your bedroom, living room, study, kitchen...

records.name: FinFeeler
records.tagline: Break bad financial habits and track emotional spending.
records.description: The first personal finance app that connects your emotions to your spending. See why you spend, not just what you spend. FinFeeler shows you the monthly impact of your everyday latte run, tells you what emotion is driving your spending the most, and we offer personal finance tools like goals, a life planner, and an in-depth budget creator. See your impulse purchases in near real-time with personalized explanations.

records.name: Pooreyoutuber Tools
records.tagline: Free browser tools for Youtubers and content creators
records.description: PooreYoutuber is a free collection of browser based tools for Youtube, TIkTOk, Facebook, Twitch, Kick, Instagram and other social media creators. USe multiple viewers, preview Shorts, test layouts, and access produtivity tools without downloads or sign ups.

records.name: Enigma Hub
records.tagline: 6 free browser-based adventure puzzle games — play instantly
records.description: ``` The Enchanted Forest: Lost Sprite — a free, browser-based point-and-click adventure puzzle game. Guide Luna the lost sprite through 8 enchanted realms, solve chained puzzles built from runes, echoes and constellations, and uncover 4 different endings. No download, no login — play instantly in your browser. Part of Enigma Hub, a collection of 6 free adventure puzzle games available in 6 languages ▶ Play free: https://www.enigma-puzzle-game.online

records.name: Merriage
records.tagline: Plan your wedding together, in one place
records.description: Merriage is your wedding-planning studio: track RSVPs and dietary needs, manage the budget, seat every table on a live floor plan, and build a mood board — all in one shared place.

records.name: Clavera AI
records.tagline: What will an AI agent inherit in your Salesforce org?
records.description: Clavera runs a read-only assessment of your Salesforce org and literally maps what an AI agent would inherit. Every automation, permission, and data-quality risk — graded by evidence before agents go live.

records.name: ZFinPro Tools
records.tagline: Instant tax, loan & salary calculators
records.description: ZFinPro Tools is a privacy-first suite of free financial calculators designed for quick, accurate money decisions. From mortgage and loan simulation to gross-to-net salary conversions, taxes, retirement, and compound interest, every tool provides instant results with explicit formulas and step-by-step guides. Fully localized in English, French, German, and Spanish.
